decisions.label: Legend bombardment
decisions.note: Damage an angry legend's lob or beam does a soundsystem (of 4000) when she's out of its reach (0: none). It always goes for her first.

decisions.label: Legend stomp
decisions.note: A legend turning angry stamps on its own area's soundsystem at once (Ed's 'perhaps'): it only bites if you empty a partying area of the legend's kind.

decisions.label: Restless time with the stomp (s)
decisions.note: With the stomp on: seconds a legend with none of its kind about stays restless before it angers (the time to bring one back).

decisions.label: Friendly legend reach (m)
decisions.note: A friendly legend defends you first and engages enemies within this distance, then walks along the ley line towards its growing tip. Default 85 m: about the average radius of an area.
